reviews.title: Tara nam ham na kiya ha
Video Quality Options No Longer Available
reviews.text:
I have been using this app for downloading videos, and previously it was very useful because it allowed me to choose different video qualities such as 360p, 480p, 720p, and higher resolutions.

However, now the app only shows 360p for every video and no longer gives me the option to select other video qualities. I have tested multiple videos, and the issue happens with all of them.

Please check and fix this issue in a future update. I really liked this app and would appreciate having the video-quality selection feature restored. Thank you.

reviews.title: Don’t open browser
reviews.text: Please enable the browser feature in the Tarab app, including access to websites like YouTube. This would greatly improve the user experience and make the app more useful. Thank you.
